notes.title: NINDO release
notes.notes:
We have now officially released the game on NINDO!
Thank you to all players who have played since the early access period,
to all Steam users who have added the game to their wishlist,
to everyone who has visited the NINDO store page at least once!
This game has a unique idea and is very easy and quick to play.
Why not practice your ninjutsu skills to warm up your fingers or kill time while you're waiting?
